scope: Step A: engine tests and device proof; the queue leaves are added by its packaging

leaves.name: step-a-connected-network
leaves.replaces: CUDA devices, streams, event buses, the model forward and the MQ transport around NativeSegmentDriver, NativeWorkerBridge, LaneDispatcher, QsaLayerDriver and QsaPrefillOperation
leaves.equivalence: ProfileNetwork's declared CPU leaves; events resolve only when the test completes them, so a host wait or a wrong order shows as a stuck or refused command
leaves.cannot_prove: device order, bytes, NCCL behaviour, real timing

leaves.name: step-a-auto-arm-state
leaves.replaces: AutoArmPolicy.manual_owned/phase/active and the armed admission intent
leaves.equivalence: the real _progress_owned predicate reads these fields; the real policy and latch are in test_e3_native_qsa_fused.Control and test_native41_autoarm

leaves.name: step-a-no-qsa-driver
leaves.replaces: QsaLayerDriver on stage 1 of the connected model
leaves.equivalence: r4.FakeDriver plus an empty schedule list: this fixture's stage 1 owns no QSA layer; both stages' real drivers run on the box
leaves.cannot_prove: a stage 1 QSA layer in the connected test

leaves.name: step-a-tp-pynccl
leaves.replaces: PyNcclCommunicator: unique_id, world_size, disabled, all_reduce and broadcast
leaves.equivalence: The leaf carries a ncclUniqueId-shaped ctypes structure and world_size, the fields the real ledger reads. test_ledger_reads_what_real_pynccl_has reads the reference source for both, and a missing attribute raises instead of hashing None.
leaves.cannot_prove: a real NCCL collective, its order on the device, or its liveness

leaves.name: step-a-tp-torch
leaves.equivalence: returns the lane stream token the leaf PyNccl ignores

leaves.name: step-a-post-seam
leaves.replaces: RowParallelLinear.o_proj entering the TP group from _flash_e3_attention_post
leaves.equivalence: wraps only a synthetic attention instance to enter the real communicator at the production seam

leaves.name: step-a-pending-peer
leaves.replaces: a peer that has not yet accepted the broadcast
leaves.equivalence: typed pending in front of the real peer bridge, as test_e3_native_tp_tail_skew; the fused path itself never returns pending

leaves.name: step-a-mutants
leaves.equivalence: named negative controls: each patched for one scenario, which must fail; no pass depends on them

leaves.name: step-a-device-admitted
leaves.equivalence: the same fields written directly because make_alignment's lane tables hold 32 pages and the proof needs 73; the operation, plan and sources are real
leaves.cannot_prove: LaneTables above 32 pages in this probe (the B5 scenario runs the real one)

leaves.name: step-a-device-delays
leaves.replaces: a decode step ahead on the stream, a busy DMA engine
leaves.equivalence: real GPU matmuls and real DMA queued ahead of the first kernel or copy, checked live with their own event

leaves.name: step-a-device-mutant
leaves.equivalence: named negative controls that skip one wait type; the bytes must differ; no pass depends on them

leaves.name: LeafUniqueId
leaves.equivalence: Same ctypes layout (internal: c_byte * 128); the test compares it with the reference source. PyNccl broadcasts the id at init, so peers hold equal bytes, which the leaf models with one tag.
leaves.cannot_prove: That the box lane communicators hold equal ids: the first box fused chunk shows it, a difference fails closed as tp-ledger-mismatch.
leaves.more_convenient: No NCCL library on the hub.
leaves.box_evidence: ledger_checks in the fused arms with 0 tp-ledger-mismatch.

leaves.name: Burst progress meta and direct submit
leaves.replaces: NativeProgress.with_meta wire key and the owned transport direct flag
leaves.equivalence: The worker seam pops the key before dispatch (executor_hooks) and direct changes only the reply path, which test_e3_native_reply_hol proves. The permit, drain and drive are the real ones.
leaves.cannot_prove: Burst pacing against a real decode loop.
leaves.more_convenient: The fixture has no worker seam or reply thread.
leaves.box_evidence: Fused live arms: progress lines, commands per chunk, capped waits.

leaves.name: s5_startup._enabled
leaves.replaces: The overlap composition settings the guards come after
leaves.equivalence: The refusals under test are the real guards in install_engine; only the unrelated composition precondition is answered.
leaves.cannot_prove: Full engine install with fused on: the engine self-run covers it.
leaves.more_convenient: The composition needs many settings unrelated to the refusals.
leaves.box_evidence: The queue engine starts with the fused settings.
